What the chairs do best

Three crafts, done properly — not a long menu of everything.

01

Skin fades & tapers

Clean, blended fades and tapers cut to your head shape and hair type — finished with a wash and style, so you leave looking finished, not half-done.

  • Skin fades and tapers
  • Scissor cuts
  • Buzz cuts, and buzz cut and fade
02

Beards, shaped properly

Beard trims with or without a razor finish, plus grey blending for a natural result. Bring a photo if you have a shape in mind — the consultation is part of every cut.

  • Beard trims
  • Beard trim with razor
  • Grey blending from $60
03

The hot towel shave

The slow one. Hot towel, razor finish, time to actually relax — the service regulars book when they want the full traditional treatment, not a rush job.

  • Hot towel shaves — $60
  • On-scalp lightening from $200
  • Little Legends cuts for under 12s — $50

Inside the shop

Dark wood, big mirrors, chairs that have seen a decade of Chapel Street.

Photography shown is illustrative concept imagery, not the shop’s own photos.

Chapel Street, since 2015

The Bearded Man has traded on Chapel Street since 2015. That is the whole story, really: a neighbourhood barbershop that kept its standards while the street around it changed — same crafts, same chair-side consultation, same finish.

2015 — Opens on Chapel Street, Prahran.

Today — Skin fades, scissor cuts, beard work and hot towel shaves, with every cut including consultation, wash and style.

Press, as claimed on the shop’s own site — Boss Hunting, Man of Many, Time Out and Urban List.

Good questions, straight answers

Do I need to book, or can I walk in?

Use the booking form below and the shop will confirm by email. If you prefer to talk first, call 0498 008 451.

What does every cut include?

A consultation, wash and style are included in every cut.

Do you cut kids’ hair?

Yes — the Little Legends cut for under 12s is $50.

When are you open?

Monday to Friday 8:30am–7:00pm, Saturday 8:00am–4:00pm, Sunday closed.

Where do I park / find you?

203 Chapel Street, Prahran VIC 3181 — on Chapel Street itself.
